nodes.label: graphify knowledge-graph refresh workflow
nodes.rationale: Query graph before exploring codebase to save tokens.

nodes.label: Workflow with the user (manual commits, roadmap ticking, graphify refresh)
nodes.norm_label: workflow with the user (manual commits, roadmap ticking, graphify refresh)
nodes.rationale: User commits manually; Claude suggests Conventional Commit messages; design changes go to DESIGN.md first.

nodes.label: RemoteStore trait
nodes.rationale: Puts Drive behind a trait so sync can be tested without the network (fake RemoteStore).

nodes.label: Build-time credential embedding (KEEPSAVE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET via .env)
nodes.rationale: Mechanism to be confirmed in milestone 4.

nodes.label: Desktop app OAuth client
nodes.rationale: Google does not treat desktop client secret as confidential; security comes from PKCE and loopback redirect.

nodes.label: OAuth consent screen (External, In production)
nodes.rationale: Testing mode refresh tokens expire after 7 days; drive.file is non-sensitive so publishing needs no verification review.

nodes.label: Google OAuth .env credentials (KEEPSAVE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET)
nodes.rationale: Optional; without it KeepSave builds as a local-only password manager. .env is git-ignored.

nodes.label: Security Model
nodes.rationale: Local-first: vault is encrypted on the machine before upload; Google only stores the encrypted file.

nodes.label: KeepSave Design (DESIGN.md)
nodes.rationale: Source of truth for decisions Q1-Q23; change a decision here first, then in code.

nodes.label: Dependency direction app -> sync -> core
nodes.rationale: Core stays free of UI, network and async so it is testable and reusable.

nodes.label: Never block the UI thread
nodes.rationale: Argon2 and network work run on background tokio runtime, communicating with UI over channels.

nodes.label: Secrets handling convention (secrecy/zeroize, keyring)
nodes.rationale: Never log, Debug-print, or write secrets to config.toml; OAuth tokens live in keyring.

nodes.label: KeePass-style merge (UUID + mtime, DeletedObjects, losers to history)
nodes.norm_label: keepass-style merge (uuid + mtime, deletedobjects, losers to history)
nodes.rationale: Honoring DeletedObjects propagates deletions; pushing the losing version into entry history ensures nothing is lost.

nodes.label: Q10 - Memory hygiene and locking (secrecy/zeroize, auto-lock, clipboard clear)
nodes.norm_label: q10 - memory hygiene and locking (secrecy/zeroize, auto-lock, clipboard clear)

nodes.label: Q11 - OAuth (Desktop client, loopback + PKCE, drive.file scope)
nodes.norm_label: q11 - oauth (desktop client, loopback + pkce, drive.file scope)
nodes.rationale: drive.file limits access to app-created files and is non-sensitive (no heavy verification). Consent screen published In production because Testing refresh tokens expire after 7 days.

nodes.label: Q12 - Secrets in keyring vs settings in config.toml
nodes.norm_label: q12 - secrets in keyring vs settings in config.toml

nodes.label: Q13 - Sync behavior (triggers, change detection, offline, backups)
nodes.norm_label: q13 - sync behavior (triggers, change detection, offline, backups)

nodes.label: Q14 - Cargo workspace architecture (core/sync/app)
nodes.rationale: Network and Argon2 on background tokio runtime over channels so UI never blocks; google-drive3 avoided, few REST endpoints hand-written.

nodes.label: Q15 - i18n (Fluent es/en, sys-locale) and assets (Inter, Phosphor)
nodes.norm_label: q15 - i18n (fluent es/en, sys-locale) and assets (inter, phosphor)
nodes.rationale: Phosphor gets its own font family because Inter has glyphs in part of the same private-use range; eframe pinned to 0.36 because egui-phosphor 0.14 targets egui 0.36.

nodes.label: Q18 - Password generator (character + EFF passphrase, entropy, OsRng)
nodes.norm_label: q18 - password generator (character + eff passphrase, entropy, osrng)

nodes.label: Q1 - v1 feature set
nodes.rationale: 'Everything KeePass does' is too large; v1 covers daily use and the deferred list is additive, not affecting file format.

nodes.label: Q21 - Tests and CI (GitHub Actions on Windows)
nodes.norm_label: q21 - tests and ci (github actions on windows)

nodes.label: Q2 - KDBX4 file format
nodes.rationale: Interoperable with KeePassXC and mobile clients, audited format, single encrypted file easy to sync. SQLCipher and field-level encrypted SQLite rejected: proprietary, SQLCipher complicates Windows builds, field-level encryption leaks metadata.

nodes.label: Q4 - Desktop platforms (Windows first)
nodes.rationale: egui on mobile is experimental and lacks autofill/keyboard integration; mobile uses existing KDBX apps (KeePassDX, Strongbox, KeePassium).

nodes.label: Q6 - Liquid glass dark visual style
nodes.norm_label: q6 - liquid glass dark visual style

nodes.label: Q8 - Simulated glass (animated blurred wgpu background + translucent panels)
nodes.norm_label: q8 - simulated glass (animated blurred wgpu background + translucent panels)
nodes.rationale: Because the background is already blurred, panels read as glass without a real backdrop blur; real blur only if the simulated look falls short.

nodes.label: Q9 - Argon2id KDF calibrated to ~1 s / 64 MiB
